implementation_notes: This is a draft guideline (안) issued under Article 32 of the AI Basic Act and Article 24 of its Enforcement Decree, and the associated ministerial notice (고시 제2026-○○호). It is explicitly non-binding and does not replace or create new obligations beyond the underlying law. The document may change before final publication. It covers applicability determination, lifecycle risk management (identification, assessment, mitigation), safety incident monitoring, and reporting obligations. The compute threshold for coverage is referenced as 10^25 FLOPs. Government supervision and inspection may reference this guideline.
